subject: Nimble Health — Implementation kickoff & schema validation for streaming + tool-calls
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimble Health — Implementation kickoff & schema validation for streaming + tool-calls

Hi Sara — great to see the interest from your team in streaming outputs and tool-calling for the patient triage flow. Per our demo last week, we put together an initial implementation workbook (attached) and a short list of questions so we can scope the enablement work correctly.

Top asks from our side: 
- Confirm which flows need streaming vs batch generation (you flagged triage summaries + live clinician prompts).
- Do you have an existing decisioning API we should call (tool-calls) or do you want Redwood to host the small routing function?
- Expected peak concurrent sessions (so we size dedicated capacity).

Next steps proposal: internal kickoff with Nimble CS + SE this week, then delivery of a draft JSON schema for structured outputs (we'll include schema + example payloads). I cc'd Dylan and Monica to lead engineering handoff and onboarding respectively.

Attaching: nimble_feature_spec_v1.pdf (spec), nimble_streaming_sample_logs.txt (example traffic).

Available times for a 30-min kickoff: Tue 6/15 10:00-11:30 PT, Wed 6/16 13:00-16:00 PT. Which works for you?

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime
From: Sara Patel <sara@nimblehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimble Health — Implementation kickoff & schema validation for streaming + tool-calls

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear next steps. Quick answers below: 
- Primary flow: live triage summaries for incoming intake forms (streaming to provide partial results while clinician types). Secondary: end-of-session summary (batch).
- We have an internal Decision API (decision.nimblehealth.internal) that can receive tool-call requests; we will need Redwood to call that API with patient-context and return structured actions.
- Peak concurrent sessions estimate: 120-150 during morning triage spikes.

We can do Tue 6/15 at 10:30 PT. Please include your SE and CS. Also attached a short sample of their expected JSON fields (we produce FHIR-lite patient objects).

Thanks,
Sara
Director of Clinical Product, Nimble Health
Sara.Patel@nimblehealth.com

--

Cc: Sara Patel <sara@nimblehealth.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Handoff — Nimble Health onboarding (kickoff Tue 10:30 PT)

Team — putting an internal plan on your radar for tomorrow's kickoff at 10:30 PT with Nimble. Customer will need: streaming partial token responses for triage, tool-calls to their decision API, and deterministic structured outputs (JSON schema) for downstream ingestion.

Customer facts: Nimble uses a FHIR-lite payload (attached). Peak concurrent ~150. Compliance note: they asked about audit logs and data residency in initial call; Monica, can you lead the compliance/Q&A? Marissa, can you draft the initial JSON schema for the triage result and a sample tool-call contract (what fields Redwood will POST to their Decision API)? Dylan — we may need a short-run test plan for load (150 concurrent) and recommended batching/quantization profile for cost SLOs.

Attach: nimble_fhir_lite_sample.json (from customer), nimble_feature_spec_v1.pdf (sales spec).

Key deliverables before kickoff follow-up: 
1) Draft JSON schema for triage structured output (Marissa) — by Tue 6/15 EOD PT.
2) Tool-call contract doc (Marissa + Dylan) — by Wed 6/16 noon PT.
3) Compliance Q&A + audit log checklist (Monica) — initial notes by Wed EOD PT.
4) Test/load plan (Dylan) — by Thu 6/17.

Please ack and add if I missed anything. I'll run the kickoff and handle scheduling with Nimble.

Thanks —
Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Handoff — Nimble Health onboarding (kickoff Tue 10:30 PT)

Acknowledged — I'll lead the schema + tool-contract. Draft deliverables attached as redwood-draft-jsonschema-v1.json (link + attached sample). High-level notes below and items we'll review in the kickoff: 

1) Structured output (triage_result) — top-level fields: patient_id, encounter_id, partial_transcript (streamed chunks), confidence_scores, recommended_actions (array of action objects), metadata {schema_version, model_version, generated_at}.
2) Streaming shape — we'll emit partial_transcript frames with a sequence_id and final_flag. Example frame: {"seq": 3, "final": false, "tokens": "..."}. Client can reassemble or process early for UI.
3) Tool-call contract — Redwood will POST to /decision with payload {patient_context, triage_result_summary, request_id, auth_token}. Expect a synchronous 200 with decisions array. We will also support async webhook response for longer decision workflows.
4) Validation — schema will be validated server-side on Redwood; if schema mismatches we return 422 with field-level errors. We'll provide a small validation tool and schema registry entry.
5) Security & compliance — Monica, I left comments in the attached workbook about audit log fields (user_id, request_id, model_version, timestamp, redacted_fields).

Open questions for kickoff: 
- Do you want Redwood to hold the auth for calls to your decision API or will you provide a service account?
- What fields in FHIR-lite do we need to guarantee retention/PII redaction rules for?

Next steps: I'll push the schema to the shared Drive link and link to our internal schema registry. Dylan, can you sketch the load/test steps (150 concurrent) so we can recommend Dedicated sizing and batching configs? Monica, please add compliance items to the kickoff agenda.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-draft-jsonschema-v1.json

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimble Health — Implementation kickoff & schema validation for streaming + tool-calls

Thanks everyone — the draft schema looks good at a glance. A couple quick asks before the kickoff follow-up: 
- Can you add a sample of partial_transcript frames with timestamps for UI alignment?
- For tool-calls: we need a correlation header to map decisions back to our events (X-Nimble-Event-Id).
- Also please include a short runbook for error handling (422, 500, timeouts) in the tool-contract doc.

We confirm the 10:30 PT kickoff and will invite our engineering lead (will forward calendar invite). Looking forward to the schema registry link.

Best,
Alex Gomez
Head of Engineering, Nimble Health
alex.gomez@nimblehealth.com

--
